summary: Feed s087_single is degraded: 66.6% encrypted traffic exceeds IDS tolerance of 60% (1 fault). No duplicates, drops, overload, one-way, or VLAN issues detected.

findings.root_cause: 67% of bytes are encrypted (TLS) exceeding the IDS 60% tolerance. Packet broker is forwarding encrypted sessions as-is with no decryption/visibility layer, so payload remains opaque.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs full payload for signature and anomaly detection. With 66.6% encrypted, most sessions cannot be inspected, blinding detection for exploits, malware and C2 and increasing false negatives.

recommended_fix.why: Selective TLS decryption at the packet broker/proxy (or forwarding already-decrypted traffic from a TLS-intercept) will bring encrypted share below 60% and restore full-payload visibility the IDS requires.
